meta_description: Southampton Plumbing and Electrical offer expert plumbing and electrical services across Southampton. Fast response, fair prices. Call us today for a free quote.
hero_subhead: Leaks, faults, or full installations — we fix it fast, fairly priced, with no hidden costs.
services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Electrical Services Across Southampton
services_subhead: From emergency call-outs to full installations, we handle every plumbing and electrical job with skill, care, and transparency.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing
services.desc: Burst pipes, severe leaks, or blocked drains causing chaos? We aim to reach you within the hour so damage is kept to an absolute minimum.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repair
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with our thorough annual service or rapid repair — no heat for long is never an option.

services.title: Bathroom Installation
services.desc: From full suite replacements to en-suite fit-outs, we manage every stage of your bathroom project to a clean, professional finish.

services.title: Electrical Fault Finding
services.desc: Tripping circuits, dead sockets, or flickering lights can signal serious issues. Our qualified electricians diagnose and resolve faults safely and swiftly.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: An outdated fuse board can be a fire hazard. We supply and install modern consumer units that meet current UK wiring regulations and keep your home protected.

services.title: Landlord Safety Certificates
services.desc: We provide Gas Safety and Electrical Installation Condition Reports to keep your rental property fully compliant and your tenants safe all year round.

about_pullquote: Every job done right — whether it takes ten minutes or ten hours.
about_para_1: Southampton Plumbing and Electrical was founded to give homeowners and landlords across Southampton a single, reliable team they could trust for both plumbing and electrical work. Based at Sapphire Court on Ocean Way, we're rooted in the city we serve and proud to have built our reputation entirely through word of mouth and consistently excellent work.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is the breadth of our expertise — you won't need to juggle separate contractors when one trusted team can handle both trades under one roof. Our customers return to us time and again because we show up on time, communicate clearly, and always leave the job cleaner than we found it.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Called them out on a Sunday morning for a burst pipe under the kitchen sink. They arrived within the hour, sorted it quickly, and the price was completely fair. Couldn't ask for more from a local tradesman.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had Southampton Plumbing and Electrical fit a new consumer unit and sort out some dodgy wiring throughout the house. Absolutely professional from start to finish — tidy, punctual, and talked me through everything they were doing. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Brilliant service. Booked in for a boiler service and they also spotted a small leak I hadn't even noticed. Fixed on the spot, no extra fuss. Great to have a local company you can genuinely trust.
reviews.author: Mark O.
